notablePrerequisites:
Predatory Urge attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Predatory Urge ability by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
